The Oathbound Warrior lives by a personal code of honor so rigid that it borders on obsession. They have sworn sacred oaths—perhaps to a fallen comrade, a disgraced lord, or a forgotten deity—and these vows govern every aspect of their existence. Breaking an oath would mean spiritual death, so they take every commitment with absolute seriousness.

This warrior seeks worthy opponents, not for glory, but to test their skill and uphold their honor. They may challenge those they perceive as dishonorable, or refuse to fight those they deem unworthy. Their code may seem arbitrary to outsiders, but to the Oathbound, it represents the only thing separating civilization from chaos.

**Motivations:**
- Uphold their sacred oaths above all other considerations
- Seek worthy opponents who can test their skill
- Protect those who cannot protect themselves

**Roleplaying Tips:**
- Always speaks truthfully, even when a lie would be advantageous
- May refuse to attack an opponent who is unarmed or has surrendered
- Treats fellow warriors with respect, regardless of alignment
